reason: Provides a vision tool for DeepSeek Harness that converts local images or URLs into text descriptions through configured multimodal APIs with automatic fallback.

summaries.zh: 为不具备原生视觉能力的 DeepSeek Harness 模型提供图片理解工具，可从本地路径或网络 URL 获取图片并返回中文描述。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with an image-understanding tool that accepts local paths or URLs and returns Chinese descriptions through configured multimodal models.

capabilities: Reads images from local paths or network URLs
Encodes image data as base64 data URLs
Sends images to configured external multimodal model APIs
Automatically retries with a configured fallback model
